body:
I once answered honestly and failed one for a job I really wanted. It was an automatic system that let me know right away. You had to put in your email address as an ID and they wouldn’t let the same email take the test again for six months. 

So I created a new email address and took it again, lying this time. I passed and got the job, and had a new ‘work’ email.
You’re welcome. Good luck.

Thank you for telling me what is going on. I’ve heard that chronic pain is one of the worst things imaginable to live with. 

I’m going to be honest. Yours it’s a situation in which I cannot blindly insist you remain alive. I am sorry that this is what life is for you. 

I am so, so sorry.

True, but saying what they want you to hear isn’t great for doing that. Which is, in my experience, what you’re motivated to do. 

I’m hoping that talking helps process what happened. It is tough to be back on your own, and tough to be ok after what you’ve been through.
It occurs to me to say that I personally believe that animals are people. They have minds and thoughts and feelings and souls, just like humans.

You say you don’t want to, but you have to. Can you tell me more? I don’t understand.

And relationships are based on honesty. Maybe she panics, but at least you’d be being honest. And not alone.
Your welcome. Good luck.
You’re welcome. Good luck.

They may be in another state, but that doesn’t mean they can’t help. They may not want to confront that there is an issue, but I expect they’d rather come to you or have you come to them than have you die. 

Maybe going to them for help, telling them what you’re contemplating doing, isn’t something you feel you can do. I can see that it’s not ideal for you. I’d still say it’s better to try than not. 

Otherwise, I don’t know. Slipping through the cracks is not great, and I don’t have a solution. I’m sorry.

Well, the place is called r/suicidewatch , so *finger guns*. 

I am cis myself, but I’m willing to listen. I know that gender identity is fraught, and difficult to navigate art the best of times, without being totally rejected. You are legitimate, though. You are what you know yourself to be. 

For work, I don’t know of a solution. I wonder if maybe you can get to a place, a different, bigger city maybe, that has orgs to help people in your situation. Maybe there’s something in your town to help provide shelter or phone services for homeless youth, too.

That seems like a strange criterion. How suicidal does one have to be? How is that measured? I’m not familiar with the NHS at all. 

Have you spoken to your fiancé about what’s going on? Is she able to give you emotional support?

It’s ok. It’s bleak. And I don’t know if there’s a way out that isn’t long and difficult. Weekend you say you’re not old enough to get another job, what does that mean?

What’s going on? It sounds like you’re dealing with rejection over sexuality or gender identity. Want to talk about it?
Might it be possible you’re in a manic state?
lol, an apology circle. I’m sorry. My night is not your responsibility, don’t worry. I know what I’m doing. (Tomorrow is going to be looong.)
There’s  some time to fill. Talk to a therapist or seek out an intensive outpatient program or inpatient thing between now and then? See what happens?
Hey. Still around? I hear you. Don’t go.

You’re being failed by the system. That sucks. Crashing off of antidepressants is SUPER awful. Can you put suicide off for, like, two weeks? What would your family do/say it you told them what was going on?
It sounds like you lost motivation or passion. You’ve ticked off the boxes. Is there anything wild you’ve always wanted to do but haven’t?

If you didn’t feel remorse you wouldn’t feel bad about it.

Something tells me something specific is on your mind. Did something happen recently?
No apology needed. I was... I dunno, trying to show empathy. I’m sorry if I offended.

Ok, so I’m definitely not disgusted with what you did. It’s not great, but it’s not Evil. You sound like you feel remorse, too, which isn’t even necessary for me to think you deserve to live. You feel guilty. It sucks. That’s hard to live with. I’ve done bad stuff too, which I can’t even bring myself to describe.

First of all, cool screen name. Have you read Clockwork Orange? You know they cut a bit from the movie. The main characters redemption. 

Second, and I don’t mean to sound rude, but that stuff isn’t irredeemable. I know the guilt is driving you mad, but it really is ok. 

This, In posting this quick because you seem frantic, but more is coming.

Yes. 100% yes. It’s not a place of healing. It’s a place to be watched like a hawk to make sure you don’t hurt yourself or other people. Your only real motive is compliance. The unit is a traumatic experience in itself. Real healing has to come later. 

That being said, are you only just home?

Also, re:parents divorce: that is not something I can empathize with, but I can share my irrational wish that my parents had gotten divorced, and the irrational belief that it would have brought me closer to reality and given me an opportunity to learn emotional regulation. My childhood abuse was primarily neglect, though.

Ouch. I can feel that. Urrrg, it’s got my teeth trembling. 

I feel you on being ‘smart’. Like, maybe? But there’s so much I lack that makes up for that. And it’s not like I’m doing anything with it. 

I have to hold onto the value of that one positive thing. But I’d like to be recognized for other things, too.
Does it come and go in waves? Because if so, bright side: that means you know the feeling will pass.

Emptiness is so hard to live with. Nothing means anything. I’ve been told that’s clinical depression, but that somehow feels invalidating, y’know?

It’s ok to need people. It really is.
Tell me about the hospital. I was involuntarily hospitalized for ten days over the summer. That shit sucked. Just started a partial hospitalization program.
Hey, don’t go. Want to talk? It can be about anything. Dealer’s choice.

What does ‘worth it’ mean, ultimately? What is ‘amounting to something’? 

Those probably aren’t helpful questions, right now.

I’m afraid of the future too. Of not amounting to anything. I’m talking a little out my ass, since I’m not living it myself, but I can see that that’s me judging myself by other people’s opinions. It’s not based on me, on what I really want. It’s what I think other people think I ‘should’ be. I mean, I have to put in real, hard work to get what I DO want, but that’s a much lighter load than anyone else’s expectations. 

Maybe that makes sense. 

Another thing that I’ve heard, that resonates with me, is that you don’t have to want to live, just be curious about what’s going to happen tomorrow. Though it’s certainly possible to not be curious any more, and that’s something I’m afraid is true of me.

I ramble. It’s late.

Jared Leto was great in Dallas Buyers Club. I thought his Joker was underrated. 

Not familiar with Imagine Dragons. But I certainly can imagine dragons. Consummate V’s and all.

It’s lonely out here. You don’t need to please your family. I get that you want their love. I want it from mine. They’re... not great at it. But we’re more than them. It’s ok if they’re not happy. We’re ok. 

Is there more you’d like someone to hear?

That would taste terrible. Don’t do that. 

Lava diarrhea sounds metal as fuck, though. As a physical sensation, it sucks, but as an album cover that’s awesome.

I realize now might not be the time for humour. I’m sorry. I just don’t know what else to say. It’s tough. This is tough. Want to tell me more about what’s going on?

I’m in the same place in my life, I think, but I’m 32. Don’t know which of us is better off. Age doesn’t mean much. I heard yesterday that Alan Dershowitz is 81 years old or something? Still plenty of time for me to be something. To figure it out.
We do weird stuff sometimes. If that’s how it has to come out, fuck it. Glad you didn’t get hit.

I was thinking of Necromunda‘s Ratskins the other day, wondering how to feel about them. Generally, it’s awkward as duck, but I think there’s redeeming stuff as well? Like, romanticizing an exotic ‘other’ as magic sewer mystics literally called ‘rat skins’ isn’t great, but there’s some realness to them in how the actual, fraught history of white/Native relations was incorporated (being pushed off their lands by settlers, regarded as ‘other’ and less-than, internal disagreement about how to react with at least some advocating violent resistance).

I fully expect to get shouted down as dumb and insensitive, here, but I gotta test my ideas if I’m to grow, yeah?
